text: I want to draw a sunrise, something hopeful for a friend who's going through a hard time.
Sky first: a light orange rectangle, 780 by 300, at the top of the canvas, background, called Dawn
the sea under it: a light blue rectangle zone, 780 by 180, in the bottom part, named Sea
A huge gold circle sitting on the horizon in the middle, call it Sun
make the sun a little bigger
five small yellow triangles in a row above the sun, the rays
give the rays an orange outline
Write "after every night" at the top, large and white
"comes the morning" just below that text, large, white
make both lines navy, white doesn't show on orange
a small boat on the sea: a brown rectangle named Hull in the bottom left
and a white triangle named Sail right above the hull, 0 px gap
group Hull and Sail as Boat
move Boat a bit to the right
Two seagulls: a tiny black triangle Gull1 30 px left of Sun and a tiny black triangle Gull2 30 px right of Sun
put the gulls 40 px higher
Is Gull1 left of Gull2?
three light blue ovals on the sea for waves, in a row below the sun
make the waves white
draw a dashed white line from Sun to Hull, a path of light
label that line "hope"
Which shapes are white on the sea?
a small lighthouse on the right: a red rectangle named Tower on the right side
lamp on top: tiny yellow circle 2 px above Tower, called Lamp
connect Lamp to Sun with a dotted yellow line
Tower plus Lamp make one group, Lighthouse
Is Lighthouse right of Boat?
make Tower the same size as Hull
undo, it looked better tall
how many triangles are there with the gulls?
a little pink heart for my friend: a tiny pink diamond between Boat and Sun, named Love
bring Love to the front
Which shape is closest to Love?
make the sun orange
hmm no, back to gold, undo
move the second text line 10 px down
Is Sun bigger than Tower?
which shape is the largest in the picture?
Write "for Ana" in the bottom right, small, gray
What is connected to Sun?
That's it. I hope it makes her smile.
